speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Hirschsprung's Disease. The combination of delayed meconium passage, projectile vomiting, abdominal distension, and failure to pass gas in an 8-month-old is highly suggestive of a distal intestinal obstruction. We have already ordered the necessary imaging; the next critical step would be an anorectal manometry or rectal biopsy to confirm the absence of ganglion cells.
